name: hermes-publications
description: DOI-anchored, machine-readable index of Hermes Labs research on AI reliability, applied epistemology, and hermeneutics. Aggregates per-paper metadata (title, DOI, license, evidence role, archive repository) in publications.json and generates BibTeX, JSON-LD, and Atom exports from it. Each paper itself is published and DOI-anchored on Zenodo; repository scaffolding here (scripts, metadata, READMEs) is MIT, while individual paper texts are CC-BY 4.0 per their own Zenodo deposits.
